inputPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied approved candidate02 Pleuromeia design. Preserve the entire organism in form: one unbranched scarred trunk, a dense crown of narrow strap leaves, ONE tall terminal cone, existing proportions and leaf arrangement, natural colors, camera and realistic neutral studio lighting. Create a ground-free single-object Tripo input, square 2048 by 2048 pixels. Remove ALL sand, stones, soil, litter, surrounding terrain and the low sandy mound. End the stem at the original ground-contact level with a clean flat base, retaining only the above-ground stem. Do not expose or invent rhizomorphs, roots, a root ball or a ground slab. Isolate the whole plant on uniform light gray; all leaf tips, cone tip and base must fit with at least 7 percent clear margins. No cropping, no added branches or cones, no text, no labels, no multiple views. Output must have an opaque neutral light-gray studio background, not alpha transparency.

review.evidence: One unbranched scarred trunk, strap-leaf crown and one terminal cone retained; all tips and flat basal termination visible; no substrate or exposed rhizomorph.
